records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no tickets, and no customer reply to welcome [email:0a8f31fe] or nudge [email:3a3f418f]. Kickoff was held [calendar:0b7658ee], which shows some intent, but four days passed since with zero product action, so unaided activation in 8 days is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Following up after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for making time for our kickoff last week. You mentioned wanting the team on board, so a quick reminder of where things stand: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready for the team, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and since you're on Team, SSO is available on the Team plan.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
